limits: No job, compiler or numerical test rerun by this audit; it inspects only the owner-supplied terminal artifact.
Complete scalar rates apply to this fixed oneGPU public walk workload. Warmups/screen peaks are excluded from repeated goal evaluation; benchmark and DP34 medians remain separate.
Fusion mode is the varied configuration. B16, minBlocks2, T256, TILE256 and CLMAD1 are fixed. Field products per scalar are5+5/B; equal scalar work does not mean equal arithmetic or perCTA footprint.
Fusion equivalence is limited to canonical131-bit field inputs and cleared denominator tags. FUSED2 masks top limbs; arbitrary noncanonical raw inputs are outside this proof.
Checkpoint v2 intentionally rejects different batch/worker headers even at equal payload length; same-geometry and same-batch cross-mode resume are checked separately.

Temporary checkpoint and DP payload bytes are not retained; this audit verifies their recorded hashes, sizes, counts and bound executable helpers rather than independently rehashing those transient payloads.
API occupancy predictions and endpoint GPU telemetry do not prove achieved occupancy, cache hits, continuous clocks or a universal hardware ceiling.
